app.name: Open Science
app.tagline: An open AI workbench for scientists

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Everything here configures the bundled OpenCode runtime — one config, no copies.

runtime.title: Agent runtime
runtime.hint: opencode serve, driven over its HTTP + SSE API

executionBackend.title: Execution Backend
executionBackend.description: Choose where the agent and its tools (Python, R, shell) run.
executionBackend.descriptionDetailed: Choose where the agent and its tools run. Supports Windows (Native), WSL and remote SSH hosts.
executionBackend.backendChanged: Backend change will take effect after restarting the agent runtime.
executionBackend.restartHint: The agent runtime will restart with the new backend.

errors.noWsl: WSL is not available on this system
errors.sshKeyRequired: SSH key authentication is required (password not supported)

model.title: Model
model.connectHint: Connect the runtime to configure models.
model.pickDefault: Not set — pick a default model
model.searchPlaceholder: Connect a provider — search {{count}} (anthropic, openrouter, deepseek…)
model.codePlaceholder: Paste the code from the browser
model.customNamePlaceholder: Name — e.g. Ollama, My DeepSeek gateway
model.customKeyPlaceholder: API key — optional, Ollama needs none
model.importLoginDesc: Copy your existing OpenCode login into the app-private sandbox

cluster.title: Cluster (HPC)
cluster.description: Run heavy jobs on your Slurm cluster over SSH — connect once, then just ask the agent.
cluster.usageHint: Ask the agent to run an analysis on the cluster — it submits batch scripts here and pulls results back into the workspace.

jupyter.title: Jupyter Notebooks
jupyter.description: Set up an isolated JupyterLab environment inside the app.
jupyter.note: First setup downloads Python 3.12 + Jupyter (~361 MB) into an isolated env — your system Python is untouched.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.hint: Extra tools for the agent (Model Context Protocol) — e.g. a Jupyter or browser MCP
mcp.description: One-click enable open-source MCP servers for scientific data access.
mcp.connectHint: Connect the runtime to configure MCP servers.
mcp.jupyterDescription: lets the agent drive real notebooks · isolated env, ~300 MB on first run

privacy.title: Privacy & data flow
privacy.description: What stays on this machine, and exactly what leaves it.
localItems: Your workspace files, raw data, and analysis results
sentItems: File content the agent reads to complete your task

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.hint: Local-first — your files and the agent's outputs live here

notebook.title: Notebooks

errors.noPython: no Python found — install Python 3 to run Python notebooks
errors.noR: no R found — install R (r-project.org) to run R notebooks
errors.installWslPython: no Python found in WSL — install python3 in your WSL distro
errors.installWslR: no R found in WSL — install R (r-project.org) in your WSL distro

notebook.empty: Type an expression and press Enter
notebook.keyboardHint: Shift/⌘+Enter runs a cell · shared with the agent
notebook.desktopOnly: (local kernel available only in the desktop app)

workflowStarters.analyzeDataDesc: Point the agent at a file you added; get figures and a report back.
workflowStarters.auditDesc: Check citations, unsourced numbers, and figure-versus-code consistency.
